picks.editorial_note: A Pritzker Prize win for MIT's Barzilay and Collins validates AI-driven antibiotic discovery as a mature, high-impact scientific field, not just a promising direction—recognizing work that combines deep learning and bioengineering to fight a growing global health crisis.
picks.title: Regina Barzilay and Jim Collins win Pritzker Prize for AI and Science Research Excellence for work in AI-enabled antibiotic discovery

picks.editorial_note: Cambridge's AI-guided vaccine design achieved complete protection against diverse bird flu variants in trials, a concrete demonstration that AI can produce broad-spectrum vaccines ahead of the next pandemic threat.
picks.title: Scientists are using AI to develop superior vaccines against viruses threatening global health

picks.editorial_note: MIT and UBC's WorldParticle model unifies simulation of wildly different physical phenomena—from sand to proteins—under one deep-learning architecture, a significant step toward general-purpose scientific AI.
picks.title: A single AI model simulates the behavior of many substances, from sliding sand to folding proteins

picks.editorial_note: Germany is committing up to €20 million in federal funding to a TUM-led autonomous public transportation testbed, signaling serious national investment in real-world AI mobility deployment.
picks.title: Autonomous Public Transportation: TUM Opens New DZM Location in Munich

picks.editorial_note: Atos and Inria's strategic partnership to commercialize sovereign AI research—spanning physical AI, agentic AI, and robotics—reflects Europe's push for technological independence in critical AI infrastructure.
picks.title: Atos and Inria enter into a strategic partnership to accelerate the transfer of research into sovereign industrial applications

picks.editorial_note: HKUST's MoU with robotics maker Unitree, building toward a joint lab, ties academic embodied-AI research directly to industrial robotics deployment and talent pipelines.
picks.title: HKUST and Unitree Sign MoU to Advance Embodied AI and Robotics Collaboration
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: Google.org funding for ANU to modernize fusion simulation software with AI shows industry capital accelerating clean-energy science, a notable crossover between big tech and fusion research.
picks.title: ANU receives Google funding to boost fusion energy research with AI

picks.editorial_note: An NIH-funded, Case Western-led consortium is applying AI to massive environmental and health datasets to untangle causes of Alzheimer's and dementia, a scientifically ambitious use of AI for a disease affecting millions.
picks.title: Case Western Reserve-led team to study how the environment contributes to Alzheimer’s and dementia | CWRU Newsroom | Case Western Reserve University

picks.editorial_note: The DOE's release of 'Genesis Agent Skills,' developed with Fermilab, standardizes agentic AI tooling for scientific ML projects across national labs—an infrastructure move with ripple effects across federally funded research.
picks.title: ‘Genesis Agent Skills’ release to support innovation across the Genesis Mission

picks.editorial_note: A $4.2 million NIST award lets SMU build a Digital Twin Technology Lab combining AI, robotics, and HPC for semiconductor manufacturing, directly tying federal funding to workforce development in a strategic industry.
picks.title: SMU awarded $4.2 million to advance AI-driven manufacturing and workforce training
